body: ⚠️ [IMPORTANT] `max_charoffset()` is already the exclusive end used by existing buffer text APIs to exclude the sentinel, so subtracting one here drops the last real character from render/layout sync and submit; use `1..buffer.max_charoffset()` instead.

⚠️ [IMPORTANT] This line-boundary path now feeds `ColumnUnit::Pixels` into `RenderState::softwrap_point_to_offset`; in CharCell mode that helper calls `as_chars()`, so Home/Ctrl+A can panic. The forward branch below has the same issue; construct the zero column in the same unit as `start_point.column()`.

⚠️ [IMPORTANT] This value is later used as an exclusive deletion-range end, so subtracting one omits the final character before the visual wrap; `Ctrl+K` from the start of a full-width line kills all but the last character.

body: ⚠️ [IMPORTANT] Handled cursor/scroll actions do not invalidate the TUI view here, and the TUI runtime only redraws on view/model notifications; arrow-key movement can update state without repainting. Call `ctx.notify()` after handling an action or otherwise invalidate from the model/view change.

⚠️ [IMPORTANT] This treats each Rust `char` as one terminal cell, so CJK, emoji, and combining characters will wrap and place the cursor incorrectly in the TUI. Compute row/column from Unicode display width (for example with `unicode_width`) and cover wide/zero-width characters in tests.

⚠️ [IMPORTANT] The last line still needs to be clamped to its actual remaining length; otherwise moving vertically from a wider line to a shorter final line can return `line_start + sticky_col` past `max_charoffset()`, and `SelectionModel` does not generally clamp those offsets. Pass `total_chars` into this helper and clamp the final line like non-final lines.
